# Uppsala universitet

> Sweden's premier research university founded in 1477, offering world-class education and groundbreaking research across life sciences, climate studies, peace and conflict resolution, and innovation partnerships.

Uppsala University is a leading Swedish academic institution with campuses in Uppsala and Visby (Campus Gotland), serving students, researchers, and staff across multiple disciplines. The university emphasizes research impact, interdisciplinary collaboration, and societal engagement.

## Core University Information

- [Uppsala University](https://www.uu.se/en): English homepage for Uppsala University with research, education, and global overview.
- [Uppsala universitet](https://www.uu.se): Uppsala University homepage showcasing research, education, and societal impact.
- [Om universitetet](https://www.uu.se/om-uu): About Uppsala University: history since 1477, vision, rankings, and global impact.

## Education & Student Services

- [Student Portal](https://www.uu.se/student): Student portal with practical information on studies and student life at Uppsala University.
- [Utbildning](https://www.uu.se/utbildning): Education overview covering programs, student life, campuses in Uppsala and Visby.
- [Kurser och program](https://www.uu.se/utbildning/sok): Course and program search portal for Uppsala University education offerings.

## Research & Academic Excellence

- [Forskning](https://www.uu.se/forskning): Research overview spanning life sciences, climate crisis, and interdisciplinary projects.
- [Universitetets roll för fred](https://www.uu.se/forskning/tema/universitetets-roll-for-fred): Peace and conflict research at Uppsala University addressing global conflicts.
- [Bibliotek](https://www.uu.se/bibliotek): Library services including Carolina Rediviva, search tools, and research resources.

## Collaboration & Innovation

- [Samverkan och innovation](https://www.uu.se/samverkan-innovation): Collaboration and innovation partnerships with organizations and businesses.
- [Medarbetare](https://www.uu.se/medarbetare): Employee portal for Uppsala University staff with parking, innovation, and internal resources.

## Community & Engagement

- [Alumni](https://www.uu.se/alumn): Alumni network and engagement hub for Uppsala University graduates and associations.
- [Stöd Uppsala universitet](https://www.uu.se/stod-uppsala-universitet): Donation and fundraising information for supporting Uppsala University research.
- [Presstjänst](https://www.uu.se/press): Press office with media contacts, expert directory, and press release resources.

## News & Updates

- [Alla nyheter](https://www.uu.se/nyheter/alla): News archive featuring research announcements and university updates.
- [Skolor bidrar till studie av biologisk mångfald i skogen](https://www.uu.se/nyheter/2026/2026-03-18-skolor-bidrar-till-studie-av-biologisk-mangfald-i-skogen): School biodiversity study with citizen science featuring researchers Andermann and Jamy.
- [Tro som drivkraft för klimatengagemang](https://www.uu.se/nyheter/2026/2026-03-17-tro-som-drivkraft-for-klimatengagemang): PhD research on faith as driver for climate activism by Sofia Oreland.
- [När känslor sätter sig i hjärtat](https://www.uu.se/nyheter/2026/2026-03-16-nar-kanslor-satter-sig-i-hjartat): Researcher profile on heart disease and mental health by Erik Olsson.
